name: ELC Bible Aventure Pixel
notes: Five-world Pixel engine pilot, David as new story. Automatic smoke tests do not certify artistic score.

hard_gates.rule: No JavaScript errors in mobile/browser smoke tests
5 biblical chapters, verified scripture references and paraphrases
2 accessible maze difficulties per chapter, every discovery and exit reachable
Real simulated Android touch inputs activate movement and no regression
Local save and upgrade migration; no login or data transmission
Biblical claims distinguished from artist-created settings and uncertain details
Tested by a human on physical smartphone before production
Tested with target-age child with observations documented before production
Previous version retained and restore path documented

status.eden: visual baseline preserved v0.4 in engine v0.5
status.noe: unchanged art quality from v0.4; technically regression-tested
status.joseph: unchanged art quality from v0.4; technically regression-tested
status.moses: first playable five-chapter Exodus prototype; 15 discoveries; 2 character atlases; pending human artwork/child/mobile QA before 85/100 gate
status.david: playable 5 chapters, 15 discoveries, one dedicated 20-frame avatar and five original scenes; awaiting human artistic and pedagogical validation
